body:
incident-bot: PAGE to #incidents: Sev2 — mariner-edge (VPC/dedicated pool) > increased 5xx rate and degraded token throughput
oncall-anna: Ack, I'm on it. pulling dashboards
eng-miguel: grabbing logs from the mariner-dedicated pool. suspicion: KV cache miss storm after rolling restart
carol-sre: seeing elevated tail latency on g4-family hosts, queueing up retry storms :grimacing:
cust-ops-julia: We're getting customer complaints, the checkout path fails intermittently. high priority for our PM team
eng-miguel: do we have a tenant policy for model fallback? last known state: model_v1.2 pinned, can we soft-switch to slim_v1? will keep outputs consistent
infra-jen: we can apply a transient override on routing to route mariner-edge requests to hosted-safevariant (model: slim_v1) — no infra deploy needed
oncall-anna: what's the impact window? estimates?
eng-miguel: timeline: apply override -> <2m rollout per region; expected latency +30-50ms, but 5xx should drop immediately if it's backend-related
oncall-anna: ok let's do a controlled override. I'll trigger and monitor
eng-miguel: command I'll run:
```
redwoodctl override create --tenant mariner-edge --scope vpc-dedicated --from model_v1.2 --to slim_v1 --mode soft-roll --ttl 30m --reason "reduce 5xx during KV cache recovery"
```
oncall-anna: running now
incident-bot: Override request submitted (ovr-6682). Waiting for deployment events.
carol-sre: seeing gradual drop in errors in us-east-1 already, total 5xx from 12% -> 3% in 4m :thumbsup:
cust-ops-julia: logs confirm checkout success on retries, thanks
oncall-anna: monitoring token throughput and error budget, will keep override for 30m and reassess. paging handoff in 45m to @mike-oncall
mike-oncall: @oncall-anna ack, i'll take followups. set escalation if errors > 10% for more than 5m
product-liz: tagging product review, may need post-incident customer communication and decision re: permanent version pin policy
infra-jen: saved command to ops runbook and attached ovERRIDE id ovr-6682 to incident log
oncall-anna: note — we used 'soft-roll' not hard pin; we preserved the customer's version metadata so we can surface the event
incident-bot: Incident ack updated: responders=[oncall-anna,eng-miguel,carol-sre,infra-jen] | status=mitigated | ov-idh=ovr-6682
oncall-anna: handing off to @mike-oncall at 22:15 UTC. if anything flares, page SRE lead
mike-oncall: ack, taking over. will verify rollback path and prepare a canary to restore model_v1.2 if needed
product-liz: request a short write-up with reasons for soft-roll and next steps for the account
oncall-anna: Will add notes and timeline to the incident channel and file a follow-up action: decide on permanent 'model escrow' or maintained safe-variant mapping for mariner-edge
cust-ops-julia: thanks team, appreciated quick response
mike-oncall: closing my loop for now, will re-open if metrics regress
incident-bot: Incident closed by oncall-anna at 1768011542 — closure_reason="override mitigated errors; follow-ups assigned"
